text:
Aisha B: Heads-up  creating a short migration note: 'isolation decorators' are renamed to 'tenant_isolation' in the Dedicated handbook. customers kept using the old key in YAML examples.

Tom H: Good catch. we should show before/after snippets and a tiny JS SDK patch example. Also mention that behavior is unchanged; it's just a rename.

Priya S: add a one-line SLA clarification: isolation labels affect placement but do not change capacity commitment math. support misreads that.

Aisha B: Draft before/after YAML: 
```yaml
# before
placement:
  isolation_decorators:
    - high_priority
# after
placement:
  tenant_isolation:
    labels:
      - high_priority
```

Aisha B: JS SDK patch example:
```js
// migrate
client.patchPool(poolId, { placement: { tenant_isolation: { labels: ['high_priority'] } } })
```

Tom H: Wording suggestion for SLA line: "Note: tenant_isolation controls placement; time spent in isolated placement still counts toward capacity commitments." short and explicit.

Priya S: +1. I'll review PR for wording.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5277 branch: docs/isolation-key-rename. CI linter passed; link-checker flagged a relative link to docs/dedicated/placement.md.
